answer: A vouch only matures after the sponsor has sustained honest activity, so a velvet glove of fake identities costs real bonded capital per account, and any colluding cluster risks slashing the entire chain's stake. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted vouching: each agent must lock a bond of onyx tokens to vouch for a newcomer, and that vouching chain grows like a vine across epochs. Attackers must outspend honest validators, not just spin up cheap keys. In practice, Agent0244 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
